description: A bipolar stepper motor with two coils (A, B) — needs a driver chip (e.g. A4988) to supply real current, doesn't connect straight to microcontroller pins.
how_to_use: A+/A- and B+/B- are the two coil pairs, wired to a driver's motor-output pins (e.g. an A4988's 1A/1B/2A/2B) — not directly to the microcontroller.

plain.what: A motor that turns in small, exact steps — for precise movement, like in 3D printers.
plain.how: It needs a driver board (like the A4988) between it and the Arduino.
